newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks end off on apathy and profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks end off on apathy and profit-taking.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange closed lower on Thursday due to trader apathy, low foreign investor interest and profit-taking, brokers said.
They forecast stability in prices for Friday's session.
On Thursday, the General Index .IGRA lost 1.19 percent to 1,564.97 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index .ISEL fell 0.66 percent to 2,092.06.
Total market volume was a low 30.8 million soles ($12.2 million) on 2,470 trades as overall 39 stocks fell, 15 rose and 36 were stable.
"The market was slow. There is no entry of foreign money," said Hernando Pastor, of T y J brokerage.

Among leaders, benchmark Telefonica del Peru fell 0.69 percent to 5.77 soles on 1.041 million shares, while miner Morococha lost 3.66 percent to 1.64 soles on 165,075 shares and brewery Compania Nacional de Cerveza dipped 1.46 percent to 1.37 soles on 968,998 shares.

Electricity generator Moyopampa EDG.N benefited from a share dividend announcement to gain 0.32 percent to 6.23 soles on 1.226 million shares, while electricity distributor Edelnor was up 1.64 percent to 3.05 soles on 139,433 shares.
